name: Warehouse & DC Operations core scenarios
description: Real Warehouse & DC Operations Q&A pairs grounded in synthetic seed data: daily throughput analysis, pick/pack rate by zone, capacity utilization alert flags, and warehouse operational benchmarks.

parts.text: What was the daily inbound and outbound throughput for South Omnichannel Hub on July 24, 2026?

On July 24, 2026, South Omnichannel Hub (DC-002) received 38 inbound shipments (24,000 units) and shipped 65 outbound shipments (32,000 units), with an average dock-to-stock time of 2.8 hours and average dock turn time of 38 minutes.
What is the picking rate in units per hour across different zones at Midwest Regional DC?

At Midwest Regional DC (DC-001), picking performance varies by zone: High-Speed Pick achieves the highest rate at 145 units per hour (99.4% accuracy), followed by Bulk Storage at 75 units per hour (98.8% accuracy) and Cold Storage at 50 units per hour (97.5% accuracy).
Which distribution centers currently have active capacity utilization alerts?

Two distribution centers have active capacity alerts on July 24, 2026: West Coast Import DC (DC-003) at 94.0% utilization (37,600/40,000 pallets with 7 overflow trailers) and Midwest Regional DC (DC-001) at 90.0% utilization (31,500/35,000 pallets with 3 overflow trailers).
How do industry 3PL dock turn time benchmarks compare to our facility operational targets?

Industry 3PL benchmarks for warehouse dock turn times typically target 30 to 45 minutes for standard inbound/outbound trailers, while specialized import or cold storage facilities often average 60 to 90 minutes.
